svg.title: QSVT 与三维割圆多面体 / QSVT and three-dimensional gate-word polytopes
svg.desc: A scalar Chebyshev recurrence supports the two-dimensional QSVT picture. The middle panel renders actual convex hull faces from 64 distinct Bloch points reachable from the north pole with at most ten H/T gates. The right panel separates a literature-only Solovay–Kitaev error ladder from the frozen exact source-query bound. Finite length leaves a positive sphere-covering error.

g.font-family: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, PingFang SC, system-ui, sans-serif
g.text: I · 二维信号块 · 多项式
II · 三维割圆术 · 有限门字
LIU HUI · FINITE H/T ORBIT POLYTOPE
固定初态轨道 / fixed-state orbit
III · 误差阶梯 · 计数边界
有限点 ≠ 整球；SU(2) → SO(3) 作用于 S²。曲率失配留下有限精度残差。
SU(2) lifts: H̃=iH, T̃=e^(−iπ/8)T; the state orbit does not encode an entire gate.
